texts.orig: 2. Legal effects of the invitation to tender and submission of a tender.
texts.text: 2. Legal effects of the invitation to tender and submission of a tender.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This invitation to tender is in no way binding on the contracting authority. The contracting authority's contractual obligation commences only when the contract with the successful tenderer is signed by both parties.
texts.text: This invitation to tender is in no way binding on the contracting authority. The contracting authority's contractual obligation commences only when the contract with the successful tenderer is signed by both parties.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Up to the signature of the contract the contracting authority may cancel the procurement procedure without tenderers being entitled to claim any compensation. Any such decision must be substantiated and tenderers notified.
